title: fix: Supabase staging reliability and session client caching
head: fix/supabase-staging-final
body:
## Summary
- Resolved Supabase staging API‑key misconfiguration by clearing cached client when credentials are missing.
- Implemented safe client caching with in‑flight initialization promise to avoid race conditions.
- Enforced environment isolation: only `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` are used; Vercel Preview supplies staging credentials, Production uses its own.
- Added comprehensive unit tests (tests/sessionAuthCaching.test.js) covering cache reuse, credential changes, missing credentials, and concurrent initialization.
- Documented correct Preview configuration in docs/staging‑env.md.

## Modified files
- lib/sessionAuth.js
- tests/sessionAuthCaching.test.js
- docs/staging‑env.md

## Test results
- `npm test`: 269 passed, 0 failed.
- `npm run test:staging`: 5 passed, 0 failed.
- `npm run build`: build succeeded, all static pages generated.

## Security
- Fail‑closed behavior on missing credentials.
- No fallback from Preview to Production credentials.
- `.env.local` and any real keys are git‑ignored.

## Verification steps
- Ensure Vercel Preview environment variables `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` point to the staging project `ufyhkmrzpynbecapyn...`.
- Production credentials remain unchanged.
